title: Editor crashes loading a minimal project on macOS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.dev.custom_build [9cd297b6f]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (9cd297b6f) - macOS Sequoia (15.7.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory

### Issue description


Around half-ish of the time, when I run the command
```
godot --editor --path "/.../GodotProjects/Experimental/test-4.6"
```
I receive the following output in the terminal:
```
Godot Engine v4.6.dev.custom_build.9cd297b6f (2025-10-22 00:09:34 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 89.4 - Compatibility - Using Device: Apple - Apple M4 Pro


================================================================

```

Strangely:
- The crash information (above) shows up in the terminal while the Godot splash screen is still up in the editor window. The loaded editor appears for a split second before disappearing.
- Other times it opens fine, so it must be some sort of race condition.

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP with Godot using the `--editor` and `--path` options.
(While I assume it would also happen going through the Project Manager, I haven't tried it myself)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-4.6_2025-10-21_21-48-04.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23046317/test-4.6_2025-10-21_21-48-04.zip)
